_about: Speech corpus for `interview_benchmark --only speech`. Each case is rendered to audio by the Windows speech synthesiser (scripts/render_speech_corpus.ps1) at the given rate, optionally mixed with noise, then transcribed by the configured speech provider and scored by word error rate. Synthetic speech is cleaner than a real candidate on a laptop mic; results are a floor for failures, not a claim about real-world accuracy.
